name: VeriLoop E2 evaluation evidence
notes: Dataset of evaluation traces the model card cites as the source of its benchmark table. Subdirectories swe-bench-verified, swe-bench-pro, terminal-bench-2.1, gpqa-diamond, aime-2026 and livecodebench-v6. The .eval_results YAML on the model repo points each score at one of these subdirectories and carries no verified flag and no harness, seed or sample-count description, so the numbers stay vendor claims.
